title: Lamb Kebabs with Creamy German Sauce
description: A delicious and flavorful German-inspired dish featuring lamb kebabs served with a creamy sauce. This recipe is easy to make and perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers.
Brush the grill with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the bechamel sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.
Serve the lamb kebabs with creamy bechamel sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
